name: Pin Bar Magic: EMA/SMA fan + pin bar + moving-average pierce (script titled Holy Grail)
author: Pine community (Pin Bar Magic v1 by Pine user; script titled Holy Grail)
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
indicators: EMA(6), EMA(18), SMA(50), ATR(14), pin-bar geometry
entry_long: Fan up-trend (EMA6 > EMA18 > SMA50) AND bullish pin bar (close>open with lower wick > 66% of range, or close<open with close-low > 66% of range) AND bar pierces the EMA18/EMA6 zone (bullPierce); buy-stop at previous bar high, cancelled after 3 bars.
entry_short: Fan down-trend AND bearish pin bar AND bearish pierce; sell-stop at previous bar low.
exit: Trailing stop (trail_points 1 pip, offset 1 pip); initial stop = low minus 0.5 x ATR(14).
stop_loss: Entry-bar low/high -+ 0.5 x ATR(14); units sized to risk 3% equity.
position_sizing: Risk 3% equity per trade: units = risk / (entry - stop).
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Not Raschke Holy Grail (ADX/20EMA) despite title; it is the Pin Bar Magic forex setup. bullPierce/bearPierce definitions are in script lines ~124-130.
